scripts.mobile:init: pnpm --dir packages/web exec cap init "Rural Help" "com.ruralhelp.app" --web-dir dist
scripts.mobile:add-android: pnpm --dir packages/web exec cap add android
scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm --dir packages/web exec cap sync android
scripts.mobile:build: pnpm build:web && pnpm --dir packages/web exec cap sync android && cd packages/web/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
